config.amendment_log_note: the frozen protocol's amendment log is empty; this implementation adds no protocol amendment, only the interpretation notes listed in implementation_interpretations below
config.freeze_statement: the hist_v2 pre-registration was frozen on 2026-11-03 before any hist_v2 model was fitted and before any hist_v2 outcome metric was produced; no hist_v2 model had been fitted before the freeze
config.primary_metric: mean per-origin average precision, R_dom, h=8 (24 months), ΔAP(M1C-B1) with the decisive ΔAP(M1C-B3) secondary

risk_sets.R_dom: established filer (>=1 material event by t) AND pair has no domain event by t; no adjacency restriction
risk_sets.R_dom_adj: R_dom AND the firm already has a material event in a different domain of the same category band

config.adjacency_definition: sibling domains = domains whose config `category` bands intersect; R_dom_adj = R_dom restricted to firms active in a sibling domain strictly before t. The literal 'different domain' reading is implied by firm establishment at domain granularity, so the category-band operationalisation is used to preserve hist_v1's adjacency estimand

training_grid.through: origin - h (strict purge t' + h <= t)
training_grid.cells: candidate cells at every quarter, same risk set

baselines.B1: company base rate (weighted, prior strength 2.0 toward prevalence)
baselines.B3: B1 x B2 renormalised to training prevalence

bootstrap.degenerate_handling: per resample and origin AP is computed only when the origin has >=1 positive and >=1 negative; the per-origin mean is taken over computable origins and the count is recorded; if more than 5% of resamples have fewer than ceil(25/30 * n_origins) computable origins the bootstrap is UNRELIABLE and no CI is quoted
bootstrap.reliability_gate: UNRELIABLE if >5% of resamples have fewer than ceil(25/30 * n_origins) computable origins
bootstrap.mde: MDE = (z_0.975 + z_0.80) * bootstrap sd of the delta

permutation.scheme: labels shuffled among cells sharing (origin quarter, domain): every origin's prevalence and every (origin, domain) entry count are preserved; per-company total entries are NOT preserved (infeasible within the frozen risk sets). Training and evaluation labels are permuted and M1C and B1 are refitted on the permuted training labels.

feature_definitions.firm_act_4: log1p(count of company material events, all domains, t-4 < qidx <= t)
feature_definitions.firm_act_8: log1p(count of company material events, all domains, t-8 < qidx <= t)
feature_definitions.firm_growth: raw_count_4 / (raw_count_8 - raw_count_4 + 0.5); last year vs prior year
feature_definitions.firm_domains: number of distinct technology domains the company has any material event in by t
feature_definitions.firm_entry_rate: company first-domain-entry events in (t-32, t] divided by 8.0
feature_definitions.adj_act_8: log1p(count of company events in the candidate domain's sibling domains, t-8 < qidx <= t)
feature_definitions.adj_share: sibling-domain share of the company's events in (t-8, t] (raw ratio); None when the denominator is 0
feature_definitions.domain_act_8: log1p(count of industry material events in the domain, t-8 < qidx <= t)
feature_definitions.domain_entrants: number of distinct companies that have entered the domain (first event) by t
feature_definitions.domain_recent_entries: log1p(count of first entries into the domain in (t-8, t])
feature_definitions.domain_age: (t - first observed industry event in the domain) / 4.0; None if none yet
feature_definitions.domain_share: share of the company's ever events (qidx <= t) in the domain's sibling domains; the domain-level analog of hist_v1 cat_share (own-domain share is identically 0 on candidate cells)
feature_definitions.firm_size: log1p(count of company material events, all domains, with qidx <= t)

power_target.rule: if the measured MDE exceeds the target the result is declared underpowered in advance, whatever its p-value (protocol section 8)

implementation_interpretations: domain-level adjacency is operationalised over sibling domains sharing a config `category` band. Rationale: the literal protocol condition 'the firm already has an activity in a different domain' is implied by firm establishment for every unentered candidate domain, so R_dom_adj would be identical to R_dom and adj_act_8 would duplicate firm_act_8 (adj_share would be identically 1.0). The category-band translation preserves hist_v1's adjacency estimand and the protocol's stated comparison purpose.

the 15th feature is `domain_share` (the domain-level analog of hist_v1 `cat_share`): the share of the company's ever events in the candidate domain's sibling domains. The literal own-domain share is identically 0 on candidate cells because any own-domain event removes the cell from the risk set.
h=4 secondary origins are the same 21 annual Q1 origins 1995..2015 as the primary horizon (both mature inside the frozen 2026-Q2 grid).
no fusion lanes are used: hist_v2 sections 9-10 contain no trial/publication fusion test and make no Target B claims.
--quick reduces bootstrap reps to 200 and permutation reps to 5 only; the full run uses the pre-registered 2,000 / 200.
deviations_and_limitations: the panel's event_qidx is the availability quarter inherited from hist_v1 (decision date); the hist_v1 availability approximation is inherited
the domain taxonomy is the current, unversioned config mapping applied to history (hist_v1 protocol section 12.4 limitation, inherited unchanged)
the domain event aggregation sums per-quarter event_counts from the hist_v1 panel; 14,704 material events collapse into 7,538 domain pair-quarters
per-company/post-hoc heterogeneity blocks are not part of the frozen hist_v2 protocol and are not reported
the 200-permutation null shuffles labels within (origin, domain): it preserves origin prevalence and domain entry counts but not per-company entry totals (infeasible within the frozen risk sets)

notes.mean_per_origin_ap_n: mean per-origin AP is the mean over origins where AP is defined; origins with zero positive (or zero negative) test cells have no AP and are listed in config.origins_with_undefined_ap
notes.holdout: post-2015 origins are descriptive only and never enter the primary test or any bootstrap
notes.adjacency: R_dom_adj and the adjacency features use sibling domains sharing a config category band; see config.implementation_interpretations

attribution_sensitivity_no_acquired.definition: identical to the primary configuration but with the hist_v1 attribution sensitivity variant: deep-case events whose applicant string is neither a registry-accepted exact alias nor parent-branded are removed before domain aggregation (hist_v1 protocol amendment A5)
attribution_sensitivity_no_acquired.interpretation: descriptive attribution sensitivity; the primary analysis uses the full frozen panel

holdout.note: post-2015 origins are never used for the primary test; no CI, no bootstrap and no p-value is reported for this block (protocol section 3)

label_purge.detail: every fitted training cell satisfies t' + h <= t; asserted in training_sample()

leakage_controls.feature_availability: features computed only from qidx <= t; labels only from t < qidx <= t + h

independent_replay.method: independent linear-scan replay of the 15 domain-level features

decisive_secondary_M1C_minus_B3.interpretation: decisive secondary comparison of the frozen protocol: M1C must beat the two-way exposure baseline B3 for incremental value

H1.criterion: H1 supported iff (a) the 95% CI of mean-per-origin ΔAP(M1C-B1) excludes 0 and the point estimate is positive, (b) the ΔAP(M1C-B3) point estimate is positive, (c) at least 60% of origins have a positive ΔAP(M1C-B1), and (d) the measured MDE meets the pre-declared target <= 0.05 AP points (else declared underpowered in advance)
H1.overall_verdict: H1 SUPPORTED: the 95% CI of ΔAP(M1C-B1) excludes 0 and is positive, ΔAP(M1C-B3) is positive, at least 60% of origins have positive ΔAP(M1C-B1), and the measured MDE meets the pre-declared target

mde_statements.h8_primary: observed ΔAP = 0.0340; MDE(alpha=0.05, power=0.80) = 0.0316 AP points (pre-declared target <= 0.05)
mde_statements.decisive_M1C_minus_B3: observed ΔAP = 0.0156; MDE(alpha=0.05, power=0.80) = 0.0389 AP points (pre-declared target <= 0.05); the 95% CI includes 0, so a true positive effect smaller than the MDE cannot be excluded

secondary_risk_set.name: R_dom_adj
secondary_risk_set.note: the frozen protocol defines R_dom_adj as R_dom plus activity in a different domain; at domain granularity that literal condition is implied by firm establishment, so it is operationalised over sibling domains sharing a category band (see config implementation notes)

premise.criterion: the premise is not supported if the primary ΔAP 95% CI includes 0 and the MDE is small enough to rule out a practically useful effect; a null with a large MDE is 'underpowered', not evidence of absence
